sentences.text: Lenny Henry and Paul Whitehouse have voice cameos as a shrunken head on the Knight Bus and painting subject Sir Cadogan, respectively.

Once Doyle chose Cocker's composition, he and other British musicians such as Jonny Greenwood and Philip Selway of Radiohead were picked to play the fictional band Weird Sisters, both performing songs for the soundtrack and having cameo roles in the film.<!-- https://www.theguardian.com/uk/2004/nov/15/books.film better source -->
The family of footballer Theo Walcott made a cameo appearance in the film.
